verdict.rationale: Data portability and account exit are fair questions for a SaaS email platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk data-export feature, open-format export, or account-exit path. Template fetch APIs and filterable delivery logs are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented capability to export all data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
